# Safety Review

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, tokens, private data, or unredacted sensitive screenshots are included.
- [ ] No instructions bypass access controls, permissions, paywalls, rate limits, or terms.
- [ ] External side effects are confirmation-gated.
- [ ] Claims are scoped to the evidence.
- [ ] Brittle selectors or coordinates are avoided when visible labels/roles are available.
